schema:
CREATE TABLE teams (team_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, team_name TEXT(255) NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE players (player_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, team_id INTEGER NOT NULL, player_name TEXT(255) NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams (team_id));
correct_query: SELECT teams.team_id, teams.team_name FROM teams INNER JOIN (SELECT team_id FROM players GROUP BY team_id) AS t0 ON teams.team_id = t0.team_id ORDER BY teams.team_id LIMIT -1 OFFSET 2
